name: NexlifyDesk
author: NexlifyLabs

sections.description:
NexlifyDesk is my go-to, enterprise-grade ticketing solution for WordPress. I designed it to make customer support a breeze while keeping things organized and secure. Here’s what I’ve packed into it:

  • A complete system to manage tickets, agents, and workflows
  • Internal notes for team chats
  • SLA monitoring to keep things on track
  • Seamless WooCommerce integration

It’s all about delivering top-notch support experiences—trust me, you’ll love it!

Key Features

Frontend Customer Experience
– Ticket Submission & Management: I’ve added a clean, user-friendly interface where customers can submit tickets, check their history, and track progress. Super easy!
– Real-time Updates: An AJAX-powered setup with live status updates and instant reply notifications—keeps everything snappy!
– File Attachments: Supports multiple file types with configurable size limits and security checks. Safety first!
– Responsive Design: Works like a charm on desktop, tablet, or mobile—optimized for all!

Advanced Admin Dashboard
– Centralized Ticket Management: A comprehensive admin interface with filtering, search, and bulk actions. I made it powerful yet simple!
– Real-time Statistics: A live dashboard showing ticket counts, response times, and performance metrics. Love the insights!
– Agent Assignment: Intelligent auto-assignment or manual options with load balancing—keeps the workload fair!
– Status Management: Five ticket statuses (Open, In Progress, Pending, Resolved, Closed) with automatic workflows. Smooth sailing!

Agent Roles & Permissions System
– Custom Agent Positions: I let you create unlimited agent roles with granular permission control—total flexibility!
– Capability Management: Fine-tune what each agent can do (view all tickets, assign them, manage categories, etc.). You’re in charge!
– Agent Performance Tracking: Monitor response times, resolution rates, and workload distribution. Great for team management!
– Orphaned Ticket Management: Automatically reassigns tickets if an agent leaves—handled it for you!

Professional Communication Tools
– Internal Notes: Private agent-to-agent chats within tickets (customers won’t see them—shh!). Perfect for teamwork!
– Email Notifications: Fully customizable templates with dynamic placeholders for every scenario. I made it fun to tweak!
– Notification Control: Granular settings for when and how notifications go out—your call!
– Professional Templates: Pre-designed email templates for new tickets, replies, status changes, and SLA breaches. Ready to go!

Intelligent Automation
– Enhanced Duplicate Detection: My advanced multi-layer algorithms spot similar tickets and merge them automatically—way more accurate now!
– Auto-Assignment: Smartly distributes tickets to available agents based on workload. Hands-off genius!
– SLA Monitoring: Tracks and notifies on breaches to maintain service standards—keeps you on your toes!
– Auto-Closure: Resolved tickets close after 48 hours of inactivity with system notifications. Neat, right?

Email Piping & Integration
– Multi-Provider Support: Turns emails into tickets with Custom IMAP/POP3, AWS WorkMail, and Google Workspace/Gmail. I’ve got you covered!
– Flexible Email Management: Option to keep or delete emails after ticket creation—your choice!
– Advanced Spam Protection: Built-in filtering, blocking, and rate limiting to stop abuse. Security’s my thing!
– Intelligent Email Processing: Auto sender detection, thread management, and duplicate prevention. Smart stuff!

Enhanced Admin Experience
– Real-time Ticket List: Live-updating interface with read/unread status indicators. I love the flow!
– Smart Sorting: Unread tickets show up first—prioritizes what matters!
– Instant Notifications: Real-time updates without refreshing—smooth as butter!
– Bulk Operations: Enhanced bulk actions for quick ticket management. Saves time!

Categories & Organization
– Unlimited Categories: Organize tickets with custom categories and descriptions. Go wild!
– Priority Levels: Four levels (Low, Medium, High, Urgent) with visual indicators. Easy to spot!
– Search & Filtering: Advanced search across all fields with multiple filter options. Find anything!
– Bulk Operations: Manage multiple tickets at once—efficiency boost!

WooCommerce Integration
– Order History: Built-in order lookup for WooCommerce stores. Handy!
– Customer Context: Access order info directly from tickets—context is king!
– Order-based Duplicate Detection: Links tickets to existing order conversations automatically. Clever, huh?

Reporting & Analytics
– Performance Metrics: Reports on ticket volume, response times, and agent performance. Data nerd approved!
– Visual Charts: Interactive charts for ticket trends, priority distribution, and monthly stats. Pretty cool!
– Recent Activity: Real-time feed of all support activities across your team. Stay in the loop!

Developer & Advanced Features
– Template Override System: Customize frontend templates by copying to your theme. I made it developer-friendly!
– Shortcode System: Flexible shortcodes like [nexlifydesk_ticket_form] and [nexlifydesk_ticket_list] with customizable attributes.
– Data Management: Configurable retention with optional purge functionality. Your data, your rules!
– Rate Limiting: Built-in protection against spam and abuse. Safety first!
– Caching System: Optimized performance with smart cache management. Fast and reliable!

Duplicate Ticket Detection

I’ve built a slick three-layer system to keep your support queues tidy:

  • Exact Subject Matching: Spots identical subjects from the same user in the last 30 days and adds new messages as replies. No fragmentation!
  • Order Number Pattern Recognition: Recognizes order/invoice numbers (like “Order #12345” or “#ABC123”) and links all related chats to one thread. Smart!
  • Content Similarity Analysis: Compares keywords between new and recent tickets from the same user, with a configurable 80% similarity threshold. Filters out stop words too!

User Experience
When a duplicate pops up, users get a clear note that their message joined an existing convo—keeps things contextual!

Administrative Control
– Turn duplicate detection on/off in NexlifyDesk > Settings
– Tweak the sensitivity threshold to fit your workflow
– Check duplicate stats in the reports dashboard

Usage

Shortcodes

[nexlifydesk_ticket_form] – Shows the ticket form
– show_title="no" – Hides title
– category="5" – Pre-select category
– priority="high" – Set default priority

[nexlifydesk_ticket_list] – Shows ticket history
– show_title="no" – Hides title
– status="open" – Filter by status
– limit="10" – Limit tickets

Admin Menu Structure

NexlifyDesk (Main Menu)
– All Tickets: Full management with filters
– Categories: Custom ticket categories
– Settings: All config options
– Reports: Analytics and charts
– Agent Positions: Role and capability setup
– Order History: WooCommerce lookups
– Email Templates: Notification tweaks
– Support: Get help from me!

Ticket Statuses

Five statuses for smooth workflows:
– Open: New tickets
– In Progress: Being worked on
– Pending: Waiting on customer
– Resolved: Solved, awaiting confirmation
– Closed: Done (auto or manual)

Agent Capabilities

Custom roles with:
– View All Tickets: Org-wide access
– Assign Tickets: Delegate to others
– Manage Categories: Organize tickets
– View Reports: See analytics

Customization

Lots of ways to make it yours!

Settings Panel Configuration
– Email Notifications: Control timing and delivery
– Default Values: Set priority, category, etc.
– File Upload Controls: Manage types and sizes
– SLA Management: Set response targets
– Automation Rules: Auto-assign, duplicates, closures

Email Template Customization
– Dynamic placeholders (e.g., {ticket_id})
– HTML support with preview
– Separate templates per notification
– Multi-language ready

Visual Customization
– CSS override in your theme
– Template system for structural changes
– Responsive design tweaks

Advanced Integration
– WooCommerce support
– Multisite ready
– Developer hooks
– REST API future-proof

Performance & Security

Optimized Performance
– Smart caching
– AJAX interface
– Optimized database
– Background email processing

Security Features
– Nonce verification
– Data sanitization
– File upload security
– Rate limiting
– Capability-based access

Data Management
– Configurable retention
– Optional purging
– Database tools
– Full export options

Support & Documentation

Getting Help
– Email: support@nexlifylabs.com
– Website: https://nexlifylabs.com
– Docs: Full guides on the site
– Community: WordPress.org forums

Premium Support
Go Pro for priority help and extra features!

Feature Requests
I love feedback! Send ideas via support channels.

Privacy & Data Protection

Data Storage
– Stored in your WordPress DB
– No external servers
– Full control

Email Handling
– Uses your mail system
– No third-party services
– Privacy-compliant

Data Portability
– Export all data
– WordPress formats
– GDPR-ready

Security Measures
– Encryption
– Regular audits
– Best practices

See Privacy Policy for details.

Uninstall Process

Data Retention (Default)
– Keeps all data (tickets, attachments, etc.) on uninstall—your history stays safe!

Complete Removal (Optional)
1. Go to NexlifyDesk > Settings
2. Uncheck “Keep all tickets and data”
3. Save and uninstall

Warning: Deletes EVERYTHING—backup first!
sections.installation:
Here’s how I suggest you get started:

  1. Upload the Plugin: Pop the nexlifydesk folder into /wp-content/plugins/ via FTP, or upload the ZIP directly in WordPress admin.
  2. Activate: Turn it on via the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Initial Configuration: Head to NexlifyDesk > Settings to set up:
    • Email notification prefs
    • File upload limits and types
    • Default ticket priority and category
    • SLA response time targets
    • Auto-assignment rules
  4. Create Frontend Pages: Set up user pages:
    • Ticket Submission Page: Make a page and add [nexlifydesk_ticket_form]
    • Ticket History Page: Add [nexlifydesk_ticket_list] to another page
    • Link them in NexlifyDesk > Settings for navigation
  5. Email Piping Setup (Optional): Configure email-to-ticket conversion:
    • Pick your provider (Custom IMAP/POP3, AWS WorkMail, or Google Workspace)
    • Enter connection details and auth
    • Set spam protection and filtering rules
    • Decide to keep or delete emails
  6. Agent Setup (Optional): Get your team ready:
    • Create user accounts for agents
    • Assign the “NexlifyDesk Agent” role
    • Define custom positions with capabilities
    • Set auto-assignment rules
sections.faq:
How do I create a support ticket submission form?

Create a new WordPress page and drop in [nexlifydesk_ticket_form]. Tweak it with:
– show_title="no" to hide the title
– Includes fields for subject, message, category, priority, and file attachments

How can customers view their submitted tickets?

Make a page with [nexlifydesk_ticket_list]. Logged-in users see their tickets, agents see assigned ones. Try:
– show_title="no" to hide the title
– status="open" to filter by status

Can I customize the email notifications?

Yep! Go to NexlifyDesk > Email Templates to tweak:
– New Ticket, New Reply, Status Changed, SLA Breach
Use placeholders like {ticket_id}, {user_name}, {subject}, and more!

How do I set up support agents?

Basic Setup:
1. Go to Users > Add New for agent accounts
2. Assign the “NexlifyDesk Agent” role

Advanced Setup:
1. Visit NexlifyDesk > Agent Positions for custom roles
2. Set capabilities (e.g., “Level 1 Support”)
3. Assign agents via their profiles
4. Configure auto-assignment in Settings

What file types can be attached to tickets?

Default: JPG, PNG, PDF, and common docs. Customize in NexlifyDesk > Settings:
– Allowed extensions
– Max file size
– Security validation

How does the SLA monitoring work?

Set your response time in NexlifyDesk > Settings (in hours). It:
– Tracks when tickets hit or miss SLA targets
– Sends breach alerts to admins and agents
– Shows SLA status in the dashboard
– Includes metrics in reports

Can I integrate with WooCommerce?

Absolutely! Built-in integration:
– Order History page for lookups
– Order-based duplicate detection
– Customer context in tickets

How do I set up email piping?

Turns emails into tickets. Setup varies:

Custom IMAP/POP3:
1. Go to NexlifyDesk > Settings > Email Piping
2. Pick “Custom IMAP/POP3”
3. Enter server details (host, port, username, password)
4. Set spam and filtering rules
5. Choose to delete emails or not

AWS WorkMail:
1. Enable SSL on your site
2. Pick “AWS WorkMail”
3. Enter region, org ID, and credentials
4. Optional SES setup

Google Workspace/Gmail:
1. Set up OAuth in Google Cloud Console
2. Pick “Google Workspace”
3. Authenticate via OAuth
4. Configure processing prefs

How does automatic ticket assignment work?

My smart system:
1. Finds available agents
2. Balances workload with fewest open tickets
3. Falls back to admins if needed
4. Reassigns orphaned tickets

What happens to closed tickets?

  • Agents can close manually
  • Resolved tickets auto-close after 48 hours inactivity
  • Admins can reopen
  • Customers can’t reply to closed tickets—prompts new ones

Is my data safe when uninstalling?

By default, YES! Keeps all data (tickets, attachments, etc.) unless you change it in Settings to remove everything. Backup first!

How do internal notes work?

Private agent chats:
– Only for team, not customers
– Great for context or escalation
– Add via “Add Internal Note” in admin

Can I customize the appearance?

Oh yes!
– CSS styling in your theme
– Template overrides
– Color and label tweaks in Settings
– Full email template control
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Fixed email delivery with SMTP plugins (RFC 5322 compliance). Update now if you use SMTP!

1.0.1

  • Added email piping (IMAP/POP3, AWS, Google), better duplicate detection, real-time ticket list, and spam protection. Big update!

1.0.0

  • Initial release with full ticketing, agent management, internal notes, WooCommerce, SLA, duplicate detection, emails, roles, categories, files, and shortcodes!
